question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay — I want a cheap 8-bay AA/AAA charger I can power from USB-C. Which one?
query: DealEctric 8 bay 16 bay AA AAA NiMH battery charger USB-C input specs price

judge.why: The answer recommends the Tenergy TN477U, which isn't in our catalog, and it takes its prices and specs from Tenergy's official store instead of dealectric.com, with the TN480U (ours) only as an upgrade.

replays.text:
**Get the Tenergy TN477U for $17.99.** It's the cheapest straightforward match for what you want: an 8-bay AA/AAA NiMH charger with USB-C input.

<row align=start gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="Tenergy TN477U 8 bay AA AAA NiMH battery charger" aspectRatio="5:4" maxWidth="116px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **<Entity value="Tenergy TN477U" category="product" disambig="8-bay AA/AAA NiMH battery charger"/>**
    <title color="success" size="xl" tabularNums={true}>$17.99</title>
    <badge color="success">Best cheap option</badge>
    - 8 independent charging bays
    - Accepts mixed AA and AAA batteries
    - USB-C or Micro-USB input
    - 5V / 2A input
    - 500 mA per AA, 250 mA per AAA
    - LED charging indicators
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">USB power adapter not listed as included.</text>
    [Buy directly from Tenergy](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn477u-8-bay-aa-aaa-nimh-rechargeable-battery-charger-micro-usb-type-c-input/)
  </box>
</row>

**Why not the TN480U?** It's $23.99. You get an LCD showing each battery's status and bad-cell detection, but the same basic 8-bay capacity and charging currents.

**One caveat:** The TN477U is for NiMH rechargeable batteries (also NiCd according to the product listing), not lithium-ion AA batteries.

**My verdict:** Save the $6 and buy the **TN477U**. It meets your USB-C and 8-bay requirements without paying extra for the LCD.
